images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of TwinD.(a) Atwinis a fake made from a real frame. Areconstruction twinis an autoencoder reconstruction with the real pixels put back inside a random grid or noise mask. Ablob twinblends an altered copy of the frame with the frame itself through a blob mask. Right halves of the twins show the difference to the real frame. The traces of the autoencoder are amplified10×10\timesfor visualization. (b) Each fake is paired with the real frame it was made from. Both get the same augmentation, so they differ only by the manipulation. TwinD is a frozen PEcoreL with LoRA, trained on batches of such pairs. (c) Mean video-level AUROC (%) on theEFSandBlendingdatasets ofTab.1. Gray bars show the best prior detector of each kind.
